title: Choose Companion's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Dak Sorting Rack. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Dak Sorting Rack
options.lineage: India Post sorting office: steel pigeonholes, franking postmarks, registered-post slips
options.thesis: Every message is dak: franked, filed into its pigeonhole, and only the Unsorted tray ever asks you.
options.viewport: Today: franked OTP slips with burning postmark rings, then the Unsorted tray, then a rack of nine pigeonholes with live counts.
options.risk: The postal metaphor becomes costume if the pigeonholes stop doing real sorting work.

raised.raise: Urgency sits on one fixed four-step ramp that sets every slip's weight, never chosen ad hoc.
The ledger head carries guide words naming the date span in view, recomputed as you scroll.
Amounts use tabular figures on a single tonal ramp, so columns of money align and read at a glance.
When something needs you, the Unsorted tray owns the screen; otherwise the rack does.
Postbox red appears only where you can act: file, pay, copy, open.

options.label: Bank Passbook
options.lineage: Indian bank passbooks printed at the branch kiosk
options.thesis: Your money as a passbook: printed entries, a running balance, and the bank's stamp on what is settled.
options.viewport: A passbook page: date, particulars, withdrawal, deposit, balance, with OTPs as a perforated strip above it.
options.risk: The most familiar finance metaphor; strong for the ledger, weaker for OTPs, bills and messages.

options.label: One Thing at a Time
options.thesis: Each item that needs you owns the whole screen, with actions on a right rail and the next one a flick away.
options.viewport: The first unsorted item fills the screen with file, pay, snooze and open stacked on the right.
options.case: Fuses well for the needs-you queue; too thin to carry the ledger and live OTPs.
options.risk: Feels like a feed rather than a calm tool if used beyond triage.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Spend as a sky: magnitude dots on a coordinate chart.
options.viewport: A month plotted as dots sized by amount.
options.case: Pretty but slow to read; nobody checks a bill on a star chart.
options.risk: Decorative where the owner needs exact numbers.

options.label: Lexicon Page
options.thesis: The ledger as a dictionary column with guide words.
options.viewport: Dense entry columns with guide words at the head.
options.case: Readable but bookish; loses the at-a-glance OTP job.
options.kept: Guide words naming the span in view.
options.risk: Too dense for the cover screen.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Load as hatch density over a tonal zone ramp.
options.case: Clever but foreign to a money and messages audience.
options.kept: A single tonal ramp with tabular figures.
options.risk: Hatching hurts legibility on small screens.

options.label: Guide Map
options.thesis: Each area of life as a flat colour lobe.
options.viewport: One lobe per screen with capsule controls.
options.case: Playful, wrong tone for bills and security alerts.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground with one action colour.
options.case: Generic; any finance app looks like this.
options.kept: Colour only where you can act.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Material 3 money app with dynamic colour, cards and a bottom navigation bar, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Today summary card, OTP chips, recent transactions list.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other expense trackers by design.
